policy: Use immutable event revisions and referenced evidence as-of each decision. Require direct/indirect target with mechanism and non-none channel, matching native underlying symbol and asset/perp instrument kind. Exclude market/venue/collateral/unresolved and spot-only mappings from asset news. Do not infer direction for indirect or ambiguous multi-asset impact. Include mixed and direction-unspecified buckets. Fixed topic taxonomy; preserve scalars and categorical indicators separately.
